question: How do net thickness and mesh size impact the quality and durability of your safety nets?
answer:
The thickness (often referred to as gauge) and mesh size of our safety nets are fundamental factors directly impacting their quality, strength, and long-term durability. At GCM Netting Solutions Chennai, we understand that these specifications are critical for ensuring maximum protection.

A thicker net indicates a higher density of material, primarily virgin High-Density Polyethylene (HDPE), which translates to superior tensile strength and enhanced resistance against wear, tear, and external elements. Our nets are also UV stabilized, crucial for withstanding Chennai's intense sun, preventing material degradation and ensuring a significantly longer service life. This robust construction is why we confidently offer a 3-5 year warranty on our products.

Mesh size, on the other hand, determines the level of containment and protection. While smaller mesh sizes prevent even tiny debris from falling and offer comprehensive safety for people, larger meshes might be suitable for specific applications requiring more airflow. Our experts guide you to select the optimal mesh size based on your specific safety requirements.
